qualifier: ligand secretion and non-canonical calcium branch
name: Wnt ligand secretion, receptor-level and non-canonical calcium signaling
rationale: All members concern Wnt signaling at the ligand/receptor/DVL level; unlike the beta-catenin destruction-complex confusables, the theme has Wnt ligand biogenesis/PORCN secretion and the Wnt/Ca2+ non-canonical branch (WNT5A-FZD-ROR2).

core: Nuclear pore complex assembly and disassembly
name: Nuclear pore complex mitotic disassembly, reassembly and positioning
rationale: All members concern nuclear pore complex structure through mitosis (disassembly, postmitotic reformation, assembly, localization, gene tethering at the pore), whereas confusables cover nucleocytoplasmic cargo transport or lamina/envelope breakdown.

qualifier: proliferation, co-stimulation and germinal centre memory
name: B cell activation, proliferation and germinal centre memory responses
rationale: Members are B cell expression modules and positive regulators of B cell activation, proliferation, BCR signaling, Tfh/ICOS/CD27 co-stimulation and memory, distinguishing it from confusables centred on B cell homeostasis/negative regulation or plasma cells.

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching, proliferation and migration
rationale: Every member regulates vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration, survival or dedifferentiation (phenotypic switching), while confusables concern endothelial activation, vessel remodeling and smooth muscle development.

core: Iron uptake and antioxidant micronutrient responses
name: Iron uptake with ascorbate metabolism and antioxidant micronutrient responses
rationale: Members combine cellular iron import/homeostasis with vitamin C metabolism and responses to vitamin E, selenium, superoxide and oxygen; the ascorbate and antioxidant members separate it from heme biosynthesis and heavy-metal confusables.

name: CCR2/CX3CR1-driven monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and activation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, aggregation and activation, anchored by CCR2/CX3CR1 modules that the general inflammation, chemokine and monocyte-differentiation confusables lack.

name: Neural progenitor proliferation with forebrain and adenohypophysis patterning
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast/neural stem cell division and differentiation together with forebrain patterning and pituitary development, which the glial, catecholaminergic and cortical migration confusables lack.

name: Photoreceptor phototransduction and retinal neuron differentiation
rationale: Members cover opsin phototransduction and its defects plus photoreceptor, bipolar and amacrine cell development, distinguishing it from retinoid-cycle and eye-morphogenesis confusables.

name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth and stress-induced hypertrophy
rationale: Members regulate cardiac (and some striated) muscle cell proliferation, growth, survival, adaptation and regeneration, unlike confusables on skeletal myogenesis, heart morphogenesis or calcineurin/atrophy.

name: Serotonin and muscarinic receptor signaling with cAMP breakdown
rationale: Members are serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine GPCR signaling plus cAMP catabolism/PDE1 dampening of cAMP-PKA, the cAMP-degradation members being what confusables (histamine, tachykinin, nicotinic, adrenergic) lack.

name: Radial glia-guided neuron migration and forebrain commissure formation
rationale: Members concern radial glia-guided neuronal migration, cortical layering, dentate gyrus and commissure (corpus callosum, anterior commissure) formation, versus confusables centred on tangential interneuron migration and progenitor division.

name: RNA polymerase I promoter initiation and rDNA chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover Pol I preinitiation, promoter opening/escape and B-WICH/NoRC control of rRNA genes, whereas confusables concern Pol I/III elongation-termination, rRNA processing or translation.

name: Insulin processing, incretin-driven secretion and GLUT4 membrane trafficking
rationale: Members span insulin processing/catabolism, GLP-1/GIP-stimulated beta-cell secretion and insulin-stimulated GLUT4 translocation and receptor recycling, distinguishing it from K-ATP/fatty-acid secretion and insulin-receptor signaling confusables.

qualifier: membrane insertion, quality control and ER exit
name: ER protein insertion, folding, quality control and ER–Golgi export
rationale: Members cover SRP/tail-anchored insertion, ER folding/ERQC/ERAD, retention and COPII/COPI ER-Golgi traffic (including connexin export), versus confusables on UPR signaling or Golgi/endosomal traffic.

name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint and actomyosin ring cytokinesis
rationale: Members concern spindle assembly checkpoint, kinetochore attachment, spindle midzone/elongation and contractile/septin ring cytokinesis, unlike confusables on centrosome/AURKA, cohesion/condensation or abscission.

qualifier: stabilization, splicing repression and ceRNA silencing
name: mRNA stabilization, splicing repression and ceRNA–miRNA translational silencing
rationale: Members regulate mRNA fate by IGF2BP/CRD stabilization, splicing repression and lncRNA/ceRNA-miRNA translational silencing (PTEN), versus confusables on ARE-mediated decay, small RNA biogenesis or 3' processing.

name: Canonical Wnt/β-catenin destruction complex signaling and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin destruction-complex regulation, TCF/LEF transcription and APC/AXIN/AMER1/CTNNB1 cancer mutants, distinguishing it from Wnt-secretion/non-canonical, Notch and Hedgehog confusables.

core: Vascular smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
name: Vascular smooth muscle contraction–relaxation and arterial blood pressure control
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction/relaxation, vasoconstriction and systemic/pulmonary blood pressure, whereas confusables centre on eNOS/NO-cGMP production or adrenergic receptor signaling.

qualifier: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing in monocytes
name: TLR2/4 bacterial lipid sensing and monocyte inflammatory response
rationale: Members cover LPS/lipopeptide/lipoteichoic acid detection via TLR2/4-MyD88-IRAK4 and monocyte inflammatory modules, versus inflammasome, NOD and phagocyte-regulation confusables.

qualifier: disuse atrophy and satellite cell maintenance
name: Negative regulation of myogenesis and skeletal muscle disuse atrophy
rationale: Members restrain myoblast proliferation/differentiation and muscle development and cover inactivity-induced atrophy and satellite cell maintenance, unlike pro-myogenic and cardiac growth confusables.

name: Growth-factor kinase signaling via ERK5, atypical MAPKs and mTOR
rationale: Members concern serine kinase signaling in growth control (RAS-MAPK, ERK5, MAPK6/4, TORC2, LKB1/TSC growth-control modules), whereas confusables centre on ERK inactivation and negative feedback.

name: Craniofacial, limb and pharyngeal organ morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover face, skull, palate, ear, nose and limb morphogenesis plus thymus/parathyroid/thyroid development, distinguishing it from outflow-tract, inner-ear/gland and neural plate patterning confusables.

name: Somitogenesis and Hox cluster anterior–posterior axial patterning
rationale: Members cover somite specification, segmentation and axis elongation plus Hox cluster modules, which the neural plate, limb and hindbrain patterning confusables lack.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst and oxidative bacterial killing
rationale: Members regulate superoxide/ROS generation and the respiratory burst in neutrophil killing of bacteria, versus confusables on degranulation, macrophage state or antifungal responses.

name: IL-12-driven NKT and Th1 activation with IFN-γ production
rationale: Members concern IL-12 production/signaling driving NKT and Th1 activation and IFN-gamma/GM-CSF production; NKT regulation and IL-12 members distinguish it from IFN-gamma response and Th1 differentiation confusables.
